messages:
rachel: Heads-up — we're missing a clear shape for actor identity in exported audit events when routing policies or quotas are changed. Need to decide fields for console filters + NDJSON exports.
sam: +1. In practice we need both the resolved human (email) and the raw actor token (service-account, api-key id) so we can trace rollouts and delegated actions.
joni: Also we have privacy reqs — exports might be pulled by auditors. We need a redaction/pseudonymization mode. Maybe export presets: full, pseudonymized, and minimal.
matt: What about delegation chains? e.g. admin A approves a rollout initiated by automation B on behalf of team C. We should capture the chain so "who changed what" is unambiguous.
rachel: Proposal: event shape includes these flat fields: "actor_id", "actor_type", "actor_email", "actor_display", "actor_source", "actor_chain_ids", "resolved_actor" (best-effort human), "change_diff", "affected_path", "change_summary", "policy_version", "rollout_id".
sam: Example NDJSON line (quick sketch):
```
{"ts":"1992456789","event_type":"policy.update","actor_id":"svc-1234","actor_type":"service_account","actor_email":null,"actor_display":"k8s-deployer","actor_source":"dedicated-agent","actor_chain_ids":["svc-1234","user-789"],"resolved_actor":"alice@redwood.ai","change_diff":"{\"routing.pools\":{\"old\":[],\"new\":[\"gpupool-a\"]}}","affected_path":"/routing/policies/allowlist-42","policy_version":"v7","rollout_id":"ro-20260320-01"}
```
joni: That looks useful. For pseudonymization mode we should replace actor_email and resolved_actor with hashed id and strip actor_chain_ids unless explicitly allowed.
matt: We also need an export-friendly flattened CSV header mapping for security teams that don't want NDJSON. Maybe provide a recommended CSV mapping and a streaming export param: ?format=ndjson|csv&redaction=full|pseudonymize|min.
audit-bot: Automatic log: event streamed to export topic audit-exports.v1 (retention 90d) — sampling=none — schema=v1.1 :white_check_mark:
rachel: UX/Console note: make filters support both raw ids and resolved_actor. Console should show: human name (resolved) with a hover that reveals actor_source and service account id if you have permission.
sam: Implementation note: resolver will try request-context link -> identity service -> fallback to session-token mapping. If unresolved mark actor_source=unknown and resolved_actor=null.
joni: GDPR: exports older than retention should be deletable. Also add a flag per-export to indicate whether PII was included (so we can audit who downloaded it).
matt: Action items: 1) define v1.1 schema (fields above) 2) add redaction presets and CSV mapping doc 3) console filter UX: support ids + human names 4) retention & export-metadata flags. Who owns 1?
rachel: I'll take schema spec + unit tests. Sam can own resolver and chain capture. Joni will draft redaction policy. Matt can do console filter mockups.
sam: ack. I'll post a tiny PR with sample serializer and fallback rules later today.
rachel: thanks — will circle back with full schema in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
